item.title: Conditional vs Children Rendering Issue
item.author: alexandersonmbm@gmail.com (Alex Morte)
item.description: Introduction Conditional rendering and children rendering are two different approaches to render components in react. Not all children rendering are conditionals, but they can and that’s when things get odd. Even though we can achieve similar (almost equal) results, react renders them in a different way.
